system.tagline: These top-heavy, armored chargers trample their prey underfoot. A monolusk will rush off cliffs or into traps just to keep moving.

abilities.name: HORROR
abilities.description: While unwarded, your tests are -1M easier and tests targeting you are +1M harder.

abilities.name: REBUFF
abilities.description: Whenever you enter a zone, each other occupant must succeed a BODY + SURVIVAL test or take 1 BODY damage and be knocked prone.

abilities.name: TURNING CIRCLE
abilities.description: When you enter a zone you previously occupied this round, fall prone.

actions.name: CHARGE
actions.description: Move, then move again. If failed, you may still move once.
actions.boons: Spend 2 boons to gain +1 speed for this action.
